crossRefs.note: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

translations.web: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
translations.bsb: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
translations.kjv: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
translations.asv: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
